staticText: Private GPA and CGPA planning worksheet. The formula is sum of each course value times credits divided by total credits. Users may enter grade points directly or choose an explicitly non-official example table. The tool does not supply an institution-wide grading rule, degree classification, credential conversion, admission result, scholarship threshold, or eligibility decision. Scale normalization shows only the same proportional position on another numerical maximum. Transcript and CSV processing stay in the browser; exact academic results must not be sent to analytics, profiles, share URLs, or cloud sync.
